package httpapi

import "net/http"

const basePath = "/internal/v1/things"

func (f *fleetRouter) handler() http.Handler {
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	for _, route := range agentRoutes() {
		mux.HandleFunc(route.pattern, f.guard(route.guard, route.handler(f)))
	}
	mux.HandleFunc("POST "+basePath, f.thing)
	return mux
}
